title: Punch Alchemy, a Guide
description: Alchemy is the process of using §cgrist§r, an §calchemiter§r and a §ccarved cruxite dowel§r to create new items.
This requires a §aPunch Designix§r, which your §cServer Player§r can deploy into your house.
Items can be combined by overlapping cards, thus obscuring some holes (like a bitwise §cAND§r operation) or by punching one card with both items' codes (like a bitwise §cOR§r operation).
